title: MCP Apps mock-ups (A0b MVP, A17b Increment 2, A25b Increment 3)

SessionCost.dc.html.title: 1 · U1 session cost: KPI tiles with coverage, AI Credits per turn with event markers, top turns, a turn expanded inline, context overhead, Copy "open in panel" command (VS Code light, dark, HC; Claude light, dark)

SpendRollup.dc.html.title: 2 · U2 spend rollup: daily columns, by model and provider, top sessions, and the in-place drill-down into U1 with its back control

Findings.dc.html.title: 3 · U3 findings: severity tiles, kind and severity filters, findings table, collapsed and opened redacted evidence

States.dc.html.title: 4 · States: Unknown, partial coverage, estimate, errors, loading, narrow 360 px, extension vs standalone branding, heading font

CostOverTime.dc.html.title: 5 · U9 cost over time: repository (VS Code light, dark; Claude light, dark) and project (Claude light, dark): basis tiles with coverage, cost per week with documented and observed price-change markers, vendor then model, tokens by type, top sessions

CostCompare.dc.html.title: 6 · U10 compare: repositories (VS Code) and projects (Claude), total, change, per session, per active day, per turn, cache hit, share bars, no earlier figure

CostChange.dc.html.title: 7 · U11 cost change: waterfall of usage, price and mix effects, per-model table with unit prices, not-explained turns, documented price changes, Price changes control

Increment2States.dc.html.title: 8 · Increment 2 states: U10 to U9 to U1 drill-down with back controls, no projects (extension), no earlier figure, unknown and partial, mixed currencies, error, narrow 360 px

Replay.dc.html.title: 9 · U12 replay: compare mode and replay mode with a failed self-check, Simulated on every figure (VS Code light, dark; Claude light, dark)

ToolCallAudit.dc.html.title: 10 · U4 tool-call audit: one session (failure categories, recovery cost in tokens, retried commands) and the rollup, in both hosts, light and dark

SessionPicker.dc.html.title: 11 · U5 session picker: the pick list in both hosts, light and dark, and the chat after the click (only the fixed "Analyse session <id>" text is sent)

Increment3States.dc.html.title: 12 · Increment 3 states: U13 documented vs inferred price changes, U14 issued statement with a diff and a draft, U15 estimate range, simulated and refusal, Unknown replay, narrow 360 px

sample.text: All names, prompts and figures on these boards are invented sample data. VS Code frames resolve the recorded var(--vscode-*) references to the default Light Modern, Dark Modern and Dark High Contrast values (inferred); Claude Desktop frames use the recorded light-dark() values. Plan: docs/plans/mcp-apps.md §5.6.
